final: WITH joined AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, c.client_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id), regional AS (SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined WHERE region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM regional), shares AS (SELECT r.region, r.cnt, r.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM regional r JOIN total t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), diffs AS (SELECT s.region, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM shares s JOIN avg_share a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(share), AVG(diff) FROM diffs
